confirmedFindings.title: Post-Increment Deduction Bypasses Minute Quota
confirmedFindings.body: The canInitiateCall check ignores reservedMinutes for currently active calls, allowing tenants with only 1 remaining minute to launch hundreds of concurrent calls and incur massive unpaid telecommunication billing overdrafts.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Account for active reserved minutes: return (quota.allocatedMinutes - quota.usedMinutes - quota.reservedMinutes) > 0;
